Package neqsim.process.equipment.energy

Class EnergyTimeSeriesSimulator

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.energy.EnergyTimeSeriesSimulator
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class EnergyTimeSeriesSimulator extends Object implements Serializable
Runs a process and its energy buses over a sequence of fixed-duration intervals.

Profiles are evaluated at the start of each interval. The process can be executed either as a repeated steady-state model or through ProcessSystem.runTransient(double, UUID). Each interval stores immutable energy-network reports and contributes to integrated energy, cost, and emission KPIs.

Version:
1.0
